# Config reference

<!-- Generated by tools/config_reference.py from the stage classes; edit those, then rerun it. -->

A config is a YAML file. `project.yaml` is one, and `oai-analysis IMAGE OUT left --config FILE` reads one.
Only the settings that differ from the defaults are needed: a setting that is left out keeps its default, and a stage
given without a `name` keeps the default implementation. `oai-analysis config dump` prints the full config.

```yaml
pipeline:
  registerer: {finetune_steps: 5}               # change one parameter of the default registerer
  thickness_estimator: {name: distance_transform}  # use another implementation
device: cuda
```

## Top-level settings

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `pipeline` | | The stages, below. |
| `device` | `auto` | `cuda`, `cuda:1`, `cpu` or `auto`. `auto` uses the GPU, and a project stops if there is none rather than run on the CPU (much slower) without being asked. |

These are read by a project (`oai-analysis init` writes them to `project.yaml`), not by the single-image command:

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `data_root` | none | The folder that the `input` paths in `cases.csv` are relative to, e.g. `O:/OAI`. |
| `batch_size` | `8` | Cases that go through preprocessing, segmentation and registration together, so each network is loaded and used for all of them in turn. A batch holds about 0.5 GB per case in memory. `run --batch-size N` overrides it. |
| `retention` | `checkpoints` | What is kept on disk. `checkpoints`: each step's outputs, enough to resume from any step. `all`: also the stages' intermediate outputs (e.g. `FC_inner.vtk`). `final`: once a case finishes, only the atlas-mapped meshes, the biomarkers and the provenance. |
| `storage.image_format` | `nrrd` | `nrrd` or `nii.gz`. Both are compressed and about the same size; NIfTI stores the image position in single precision, so resuming from it can change results slightly. |
| `storage.transform_format` | `h5` | `h5` (compressed, about 70 MB) or `tfm` (text, about 300 MB, readable). |

## Stages

Every stage has a `name` and its parameters. Some parameters are marked:
- *check*: a threshold of the stage's sanity checks. Changing it rechecks the saved outputs without redoing the step.
- *speed*: changes how fast the stage runs, not what it computes. Changing it does not make outputs outdated.

Changing any other parameter makes the step, and every step after it, outdated, so `run` redoes them.

### `preprocessor`: read and prepare the image

#### `oai_default` (default)

`oai_analysis.stages.preprocessing.OAIPreprocessor`

Mirror right knees to look like left ones, reorient to the atlas orientation, and window the intensities.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `window_min_percentile` | `0.1` | Intensities at or below this percentile become 0 |
| `window_max_percentile` | `99.9` | Intensities at or above this percentile become 1 |
| `expected_spacing_mm` | `[0.365, 0.365, 0.7]` | *check*. OAI sagittal 3D DESS; review if 10% off |
| `expected_size` | `[384, 384, 160]` | *check*. Voxels, OAI sagittal 3D DESS; review if different |

### `segmenter`: cartilage probability maps

#### `unet3d_oai` (default)

`oai_analysis.stages.segmentation.unet.UNetSegmenter`

The 3D U-Net trained on OAI knees, applied in overlapping patches.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `batch_size` | `4` | *speed*. Patches per pass through the network |
| `overlap_size` | `[16, 16, 8]` | Voxels shared by neighbouring patches |
| `fc_volume_ml` | `[4.0, 20.0]` | *check*. Usual range of the femoral cartilage volume |
| `tc_volume_ml` | `[1.5, 8.0]` | *check*. Usual range of the tibial cartilage volume |
| `max_outside_main_pieces` | `0.05` | *check*. Share of the volume outside the largest piece (FC) or two (TC) |
| `max_uncertainty` | `0.3` | *check*. Mean of 1 - &#124;2p - 1&#124; over the cartilage |

#### `precomputed`

`oai_analysis.stages.segmentation.precomputed.PrecomputedSegmenter`

Probability maps made earlier, e.g. by an earlier run or another program, read from files.

path is a template for each map's file. These fill it in: {structure} (FC or TC), {case_id}, {laterality},
{LATERALITY} (upper case) and the columns of a project's cases.csv, e.g. {patient_id} and {month}. The maps are
resampled onto the preprocessed image, so they have to be in its physical space, as a run's FC_prob.nrrd is.
The files are not part of the fingerprint: after they change, redo the step with `run --from segment`.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `'{case_id}/{structure}_prob.nrrd'` | Template of each map's file, see above |
| `fc_volume_ml` | `[4.0, 20.0]` | *check*. Usual range of the femoral cartilage volume |
| `tc_volume_ml` | `[1.5, 8.0]` | *check*. Usual range of the tibial cartilage volume |
| `max_outside_main_pieces` | `0.05` | *check*. Share of the volume outside the largest piece (FC) or two (TC) |
| `max_uncertainty` | `0.3` | *check*. Mean of 1 - &#124;2p - 1&#124; over the cartilage |

### `registerer`: register the image to the atlas

#### `unigradicon` (default)

`oai_analysis.stages.registration.UniGradICONRegisterer`

uniGradICON, fine-tuned on each image pair.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `finetune_steps` | `2` | Steps of fine-tuning the network on each image pair; 0: none |
| `max_folding` | `0.01` | *check*. Fraction of the displacement field with a Jacobian determinant <= 0 |
| `min_similarity` | `0.75` | *check*. Correlation of the warped image with the atlas image |

#### `gradicon_knee`

`oai_analysis.stages.registration.GradICONKneeRegisterer`

GradICON trained on OAI knees (icon_registration's OAI_knees_gradICON_model), the registration the pipeline
used before uniGradICON. finetune_steps: 0 uses the network as trained, as that pipeline did.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `finetune_steps` | `0` | Steps of fine-tuning the network on each image pair; 0: none |
| `max_folding` | `0.01` | *check*. Fraction of the displacement field with a Jacobian determinant <= 0 |
| `min_similarity` | `0.75` | *check*. Correlation of the warped image with the atlas image |

### `mesh_generator`: cartilage surfaces

#### `cuberille` (default)

`oai_analysis.stages.meshing.CuberilleMeshGenerator`

Cuberille iso-surface of the probability map, with vertices projected onto the iso-surface.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `iso_surface_value` | `0.5` | The probability where the surface is |
| `project_vertex_surface_distance_threshold` | `0.05` | How close (mm) a projected vertex gets to the surface |

#### `marching_cubes`

`oai_analysis.stages.meshing.MarchingCubesMeshGenerator`

Marching cubes iso-surface of the probability map (scikit-image), optionally smoothed.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `iso_surface_value` | `0.5` | The probability where the surface is |
| `smoothing_iterations` | `0` | Smoothing passes over the surface; 0: none |

### `thickness_estimator`: thickness on the surfaces

#### `mesh_splitting` (default)

`oai_analysis.stages.thickness.MeshSplittingThickness`

Split the surface into inner/outer in atlas space; measure inner-outer distance in patient space.

back_mapping chooses how the split gets back to patient space:
"cell_ids" cuts the halves out of the original patient mesh, by the ids of the cells in each half;
"transform" (version 1) transforms the halves of the smoothed atlas-space mesh back.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `smoothing_iterations` | `150` | Smoothing passes over the atlas-space mesh before it is split |
| `island_distance_threshold_mm` | `10.0` | Pieces farther than this from the atlas surface are dropped |
| `back_mapping` | `cell_ids` | "cell_ids" or "transform", see above |
| `max_thickness_mm` | `6.0` | *check*. Thicker than this is implausible |
| `max_too_thick` | `0.01` | *check*. Fraction of the vertices thicker than max_thickness_mm |

#### `distance_transform`

`oai_analysis.stages.thickness.DistanceTransformThickness`

Thickness from a distance transform of the segmentation mask, sampled at the mesh vertices.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `distance_map_method` | `parabolic_morphology` | "parabolic_morphology" or "signed_maurer" |
| `max_thickness_mm` | `6.0` | *check*. Thicker than this is implausible |
| `max_too_thick` | `0.01` | *check*. Fraction of the vertices thicker than max_thickness_mm |

### `atlas_mapper`: carry the thickness onto the atlas surface

#### `closest_point` (default)

`oai_analysis.stages.atlas_mapping.ClosestPointAtlasMapper`

Move the patient mesh into atlas space and give each atlas vertex the thickness of the closest patient point.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `max_without_thickness` | `0.15` | *check*. Fraction of the atlas surface without thickness; above it, the case needs review. In the benchmark cases and the Dec 18, 2024 triage, the clean cases stay below 0.15 and most problem cases are above it |

### `biomarker_extractors`: results computed from everything above (a list)

#### `thickness_map_2d` (default)

`oai_analysis.stages.biomarkers.ThicknessMap2D`

Thickness on the atlas, interpolated over the atlas' 2D embedding: an array and a picture per structure.

| Parameter | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `grid_resolution` | `300` | Grid points along each side of the 2D map |
